patch.title: 去掉未经验证的具体数字“73%”，改为谨慎表述并标注数据待核实、来源待补。

hunks.oldText: The draft claims a 73 percent performance improvement, but no source is recorded.
hunks.newText: The draft reports a performance improvement; however, the exact figure and its supporting data are pending verification, and the source has yet to be provided.
